definition: A protein complex that possesses UDP-N-acetylglucosamine-lysosomal-enzyme N-acetylglucosaminephosphotransferase activity; the bovine complex contains disulfide-linked homodimers of 166- and 51-kDa subunits and two identical, noncovalently associated 56-kDa subunits.
label: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine-lysosomal-enzyme N-acetylglucosaminephosphotransferase complex
